title: Custom Baseball Jersey Maker (2026)
verdict: Wooter has the best custom baseball jersey maker in 2026. Start from a baseball style, set the colors, add your script or logo and enter the roster. The preview and the price change with every edit.

Boombah is the alternative to try: its builders cover sublimated jerseys and pants. Champro's Uniform Builder is good if you order through a dealer. Custom Ink is for printed jerseys on a deadline. Nike Team's builder is for dealer programs.

ranking.fit: Travel and school teams that want to build jersey, pants and jacket from one design and see the price first.
ranking.lacks: Made to order. About three weeks from order to delivery.

ranking.fit: Teams that want to build sublimated jerseys and pants and buy direct from the maker.
ranking.lacks: Its baseball pages quote different lead times. Check the product you pick.

ranking.fit: Coaches with a dealer who want to lay out a Juice or stock uniform.
ranking.lacks: The builder saves a design. A dealer account places the order.

ranking.fit: Rec teams printing names and numbers on a stock jersey.
ranking.lacks: A print tool, not a baseball uniform builder.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and work with an authorized dealer.

why: Baseball asks more of a jersey maker than most sports. It has to handle buttons, a chest script, sleeve trim and numbers front and back.
Wooter's builder carries the finished design onto pants and jackets. The roster, with each player's name, number and size, copies across so you enter it once.
No time to design? The design service is free and returns a mockup in 1 to 2 business days.

criteria.name: Handles baseball details
criteria.text: Buttons, script and trim, not a generic tee.

criteria.name: Pants and jackets
criteria.text: The same design across the uniform.

faq.q: What is the best baseball jersey maker for a travel team?
faq.a: One that builds the whole uniform. Wooter and Boombah both make jerseys and pants from the same design.

faq.q: Can I make a pinstripe jersey?
faq.a: Yes. Pinstripe is one of the styles in Wooter's catalog.

faq.q: Is the maker free to use?
faq.a: Yes at Wooter. You pay when you order.
Wooter's roster builder takes each player's size and quantity. Custom Ink has a group order form where players pick their own.
About three weeks from Wooter after you order. Paid rush cuts that to one to two weeks. Boombah's baseball pages quote one to three weeks on one and three weeks on another.
